sloka: मां च दृष्ट्वा वने तस्मिन् समागम्य ततस्ततः ।ताः समभ्यागताः क्षिप्रं रावणायाचचक्षिरे ।। ५.५८.११० ।।।।
transliteration: māṁ ca dṛṣṭvā vane tasmin samāgamya tatastataḥ ।tāḥ samabhyāgatāḥ kṣipraṁ rāvaṇāyācacakṣire ।। 5.58.110 ।।।।

translations.english: Seeing me in that garden and gathering from here and there, the demonesses at once understood and reported it to Ravana.
